connectionFields.obtainedHow: Operator-chosen label in Entro; not a secret.

connectionFields.name: Username
connectionFields.obtainedHow: Domain-qualified service account that can read the share (e.g. DOMAIN\user).

connectionFields.name: Password
connectionFields.obtainedHow: Password for that service account; store in the operator vault.

connectionFields.name: File Share IP or Hostname
connectionFields.obtainedHow: Host:445 of the file server as shown in Entro's SMB form.

prepSteps.title: Create a read-only share account
prepSteps.instruction: On the file server or AD, create a service account with read access to the target shares and confirm port 445 is reachable from the Connector host.
prepSteps.evidence: The account can list the share and the Connector host reaches host:445

uncataloged.evidence: The account can list the share and the Connector host reaches host:445

prepSteps.title: Create a read-only share account
prepSteps.instruction: On the file server or AD, create a service account with read access to the target shares and confirm port 445 is reachable from the Connector host.
prepSteps.evidence: The account can list the share and the Connector host reaches host:445

uncataloged.evidence: The account can list the share and the Connector host reaches host:445

prepSteps.title: Prepare the SMB JSON template
prepSteps.instruction: Fill Entro's SMB JSON template for each server and upload it on Add New Account instead of entering one share at a time.
prepSteps.evidence: Entro accepts the JSON upload and lists the shares

uncataloged.evidence: Entro accepts the JSON upload and lists the shares

connectionFields.name: Nickname
connectionFields.obtainedHow: Operator-chosen label in Entro; not a secret.

connectionFields.name: Host
connectionFields.obtainedHow: DNS or IP of the SFTP server (optionally with port).

connectionFields.name: Username
connectionFields.obtainedHow: SFTP user with read access to the target directories.

connectionFields.name: Private Key
connectionFields.obtainedHow: SSH private key for that user if not using a password; store in the operator vault.

connectionFields.name: Passphrase (optional)
connectionFields.obtainedHow: Passphrase for the private key if it is encrypted; omit when unused.

prepSteps.title: Provision an SFTP reader
prepSteps.instruction: Create an SFTP user limited to the directories Entro should scan and confirm SSH reachability from the Connector host.
prepSteps.evidence: SFTP login from the Connector host lists the target directories

uncataloged.evidence: SFTP login from the Connector host lists the target directories

connectionFields.name: Nickname
connectionFields.obtainedHow: Operator-chosen label in Entro; not a secret.

connectionFields.name: Host
connectionFields.obtainedHow: DNS or IP of the Windows host with WinRM enabled.

connectionFields.name: Username
connectionFields.obtainedHow: WinRM user with read access to the target paths.

connectionFields.name: Password
connectionFields.obtainedHow: Password for that user when not using a key; store in the operator vault.

prepSteps.title: Enable WinRM for the Connector
prepSteps.instruction: On each Windows host, enable WinRM, allow the Connector source, and grant a service account read access to the directories to scan.
prepSteps.evidence: WinRM responds from the Connector host with the service account

uncataloged.evidence: WinRM responds from the Connector host with the service account
